cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1988; The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1991 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Completed after August move to Texas. See cat. nos. 135–57, 159–62. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Rippling black semicircles occupy the center of an otherwise plain white sheet of paper. The semicircles are softly shaded and fade from black at their top edges to light gray at the bottom.
